result.summary: The overall layout is clean and functional, but the main visual problem is in the promotional banner: white/light text on a pale mint background has very low contrast, making the headline, promo details, and promo code hard to read.

issues.description: The '3 free deliveries for you' headline and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' text in the green promo banner are rendered in white/very light color on a pale mint background, resulting in extremely low contrast and poor readability.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text to a dark color (e.g., dark green or charcoal) or darken the banner background to ensure WCAG-compliant contrast (at least 4.5:1 for body text).

issues.description: The promo code 'TALLINN3' is critical information for redeeming the offer but is embedded in low-contrast small text and easy to miss.
issues.suggestion: Make the promo code stand out (e.g., bold, dark text, or a dashed 'copy code' chip) so users can easily notice and copy it.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' row (Trattoria Piccola) is cut off at the right edge, which is expected for a horizontal carousel but may suggest a broken layout at first glance.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle partial-card hint or scroll indicator so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable.
